macros.name: indextrafirstmark
macros.doc: The first mark on the current page, with the macro \indextramakemark applied.

macros.name: indextrakeyword
macros.doc: This macro is used to typeset a keyword for an entry of level ⟨level⟩.

macros.name: indextralastmark
macros.doc: The last mark on the current page, with the macro \indextramakemark applied.

macros.name: indextramakecontinuation
macros.doc: This macro is used to generate a continuation text when the entry at ⟨level⟩ with the supplied ⟨keyword⟩ contains a column break.

macros.name: indextramakegroupheading
macros.doc: This macro is used to generate a heading for ⟨group⟩.

macros.name: indextramakemark
macros.doc: Macro to process an indextra mark for use.

macros.name: indextrapage
macros.doc: This command is used to typeset a reference to a single page.

macros.name: indextrarange
macros.doc: This command is used to typeset a reference to a range of pages.

macros.name: indextrasetup
macros.doc: This command is used to specify options. The argument ⟨options⟩ is a key–value list.
